title: Puthoff and Davis describe how the legacy UFO program recruits

plain: A researcher who appeared as a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast passes on what two physicists, Hal Puthoff and Eric Davis, told them about the "legacy program", a claimed hidden, long-running US effort to study UFOs. According to the guest, Puthoff and Davis said the way in is to first apply to one of the major aerospace companies said to be part of that program. If true, that would make private defence firms the front door to a secret project.
